description: Bulk-set cost-driver custom field values on items — the operation that makes them quotable via generate_price_book_profiles. Best practice: call preview_spec_fill first to see what would change, then call this with the same parameters to commit. Every fill records provenance (source, sourceRef, timestamp) and captures per-item before-values for reversal via reverse_spec_fill.

bookId.description: Optional price book id (GUID) — context for what motivated this fill.

itemIds.description: List of item ids (GUIDs) to fill. Max 500.

itemSkus.description: List of item SKUs to fill. Max 500.

source.description: How the values were sourced: OperatorAsserted (default), CsvImported, or VendorConfirmed.

spec.description: Attribute values to set, keyed by custom field fieldName (e.g. {"binding": "Perfect", "trim_width": 6}).

templateId.description: Template id (GUID) — uses the template's saved spec values.

name: apply_spec_fill
title: Apply Spec Fill
